I have resolved the issue where proxy authentication resulted in an HTTP 407 error.

### Root Cause
When proxy URLs containing authentication credentials (e.g. `http://user:pass@host:port`) were processed in `HTTPAdapter.send()`, `prepend_scheme_if_needed()` parsed the URL with `urllib3.util.parse_url`. In `urllib3`, `parse_url().netloc` only contains `host:port` (excluding the `auth` component). As a result, `prepend_scheme_if_needed()` omitted the user credentials when re-assembling the URL with `urlunparse()`, stripping authentication details before `proxy_headers()` or `proxy_manager_for()` could extract them and set the `Proxy-Authorization` header.

### Fix
1. Updated `prepend_scheme_if_needed()` in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/requests/utils.py#L960-L982) to properly handle URLs without schemes and retain `auth` in `netloc` when re-assembling URLs.
2. Updated `get_auth_from_url()` in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/requests/utils.py#L985-L1000) to ensure proxy URLs without a scheme or with empty passwords are properly handled without losing username information.
3. Updated `rebuild_proxies()` in [requests/sessions.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/requests/sessions.py#L291-L297) to check for presence of `username` rather than requiring both `username` and `password` to be non-empty.
4. Added test cases in [tests/test_utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/tests/test_utils.py#L396-L406) verifying authentication parsing and scheme prepending on URLs with embedded credentials.
The issue has been resolved.

### Root Cause
When proxy URLs with authentication credentials (e.g., `http://user:pass@host:port`) were passed to `requests`, `HTTPAdapter.send()` invoked `prepend_scheme_if_needed(proxy, 'http')`. Because `prepend_scheme_if_needed` used `urllib3.util.parse_url()` and reassembled the URL using `urlunparse()`, it omitted `parsed.auth` (`user:pass`), stripping credentials from the proxy URL before `proxy_headers()` or `proxy_manager_for()` could extract them to build the `Proxy-Authorization` header. As a result, proxy requests were sent unauthenticated, returning HTTP 407.

### Fix
1. Updated `prepend_scheme_if_needed()` in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) to preserve the `auth` component in `netloc` when re-assembling URLs and handle schemes without `://`.
2. Updated `get_auth_from_url()` in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/requests/utils.py#L988-L1005) to parse user credentials properly without raising errors or dropping usernames when passwords are empty.
3. Updated `rebuild_proxies()` in [requests/sessions.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/requests/sessions.py#L291-L297) to set `Proxy-Authorization` header whenever a username is present.
4. Added test cases in [tests/test_utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ciu0l1v0/tests/test_utils.py#L396-L406) covering URLs with credentials with and without explicit schemes.
